title: Willie Webber, Buddy Petit, Kid Rena and Black Benny
summary: Recollections of trumpeters who contested from wagons, Rena's decline, Sharkey's debt to him, and drummer Black Benny's hold-that-tiger gimmick.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: remember uh uh Willie Webber used to live on Mero Street, the trumpet player? He used to be a Slater?

Yeah, yeah, Willie Webber. He was, he was long in the middle. That was, that was my, my aunt's brother-in-law. He was a good trumpet player. Yeah, my, my uncle married his sister, Willie Webber, yeah. They got so many of the trumpet players, they had real good trumpeters way back there. Many of them, they haven't came to my mind yet, you know. Speaking of trumpet players, do you remember Buddy Petit? Yeah, yes. Buddy Petit was real good. He was one of the top notches, Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit, Louis Armstrong, Kid Rainey, and Kid Punch, Sam Morgan. Those was the guys who used to back them wagons up there and they'd contest against each other. One, it was just a matter of opinion. See, now you see like Louis Armstrong would be blowing uh those high notes. Rainey used to blow in the KSC. Yeah. But uh, towards the late years, I mean he played people with him towards the late years, but he wasn't near as good when he was young because he had took to drinking, you know. He had gave it up for a time, see. And uh... He wasn't as good in his late years, you said. No, he wasn't half as good. That guy blew a trumpet. Oh, he blew a trumpet. I mean it was... You know uh, who uh, took pattern after him? You ever hear Sharky Banana? Yeah. Sharky Banana used to come and sit and listen to him. Now Sharky Banana, Rainey used to give Sharky Banana ideas. Louis Armstrong would give Louis Prima ideas. Now uh, uh, Sharky Banana, their name was Montgomery. He had a brother that was a real good drummer. They called Roy Montgomery. Oh, yeah. Yeah, he was a real good drummer, see. Well, he gave up the drums. I mean he was supposed to give it up. And um, he used to follow behind Benny. They had a guy they called Benny. He was the guy who first started putting all those different kind of gadgets. You see, like he used to play the tiger rag and hold that tiger at uh, at the lyric show. And when you say hold the tiger, he had a big old hat box with a cord and you pull it and make the tiger holler. He was a drummer. And he... Black Benny. Black Benny. That's they called him.
